causes.label: wind_output
causes.quote: Semi-scheduled wind for the 6.30 am trading interval was forecast to be around 900 MW both four and 12 hours ahead and around 820 MW half an hour ahead. Actual semi-scheduled wind output was only around 600 MW, dropping around 150 MW over the 6.30 am trading interval.

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: On the day, two gas generators were unavailable on planned outages, Pelican Point (480 MW) and Torrens Island B3 (200 MW).

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: Planned network outages, at Tailem Bend to complete augmentation works on the Heywood Interconnector between Victoria and South Australia, materially reduced its capacity.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: MurrayLink was importing at its limit of around 220 MW.

causes.label: ramp_rates
causes.quote: all low priced generation either fully dispatched, ramp rate limited or limited by their Fast Start Inflexibility Profile (FSIP), taking more than five minutes to start
